Long-awaited call

Tom had a very special reason for getting up early the next day, so he set the alarm for 6 am. The main reason was that he had been waiting for six months to win a radio lottery. The prize was a concert trip to Australia. To win, you had to call the radio station and name the "star of the hour". As Tom was the number one fan of this radio station, he knew all the "stars of the hour" by heart.

In the morning, Tom was ready to make a call. Exactly at 6 am, he dialed the number. He was really nervous. After a few beeps, he heard a voice! Tom immediately named the star, but then the connection was cut off. He was shocked. A few minutes later, the radio station called him back, congratulated him on his victory, and apologized for the technical problems.

A week later, Tom was packing his luggage. He still couldn't believe that he had won and that it wasn't a dream. The flight to Australia took him 12 hours, and he arrived feeling really tired. However, all his exhaustion disappeared when he checked into a luxurious hotel. Soon, he went to the concert, where the famous star personally congratulated him on winning the lottery right on stage. It was an unforgettable journey, and Tom absolutely loved his trip to Australia!
